fields.text: Reading guide page 2 of 10: the three POSIX entry points the shim replaces (mmap, munmap, mprotect), the request-shape filter, forwarding to libc, and guard creation. The claim to weigh: a refusal here means the shim cannot do this exactly, never that this caller may not. About 15 minutes.
Page 2: all four claims confirmed. Page 3 is posted as q9 (reservations).
